# Junk Junkies Indiana

> Junk removal, cleanouts and light demolition in Indianapolis and surrounding Indiana cities. Phone/text: (317) 637-8807. Part of Junk Junkies (Texas HQ, Florida, Indiana).

## Services
- [Storage Unit Cleanouts](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/storage-unit-cleanouts-indianapolis/): We empty your storage unit and haul it all away.
- [Estate Cleanouts](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/estate-cleanouts-indianapolis/): Respectful whole-home cleanouts for families and estates.
- [Garage Cleanouts](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/garage-cleanouts-indianapolis/): Get your garage back, cleared out and swept.
- [Curbside Junk Pickup](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/curbside-junk-pickup-indianapolis/): Pile it at the curb and we haul it away.
- [Shed Removal](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/shed-removal-indianapolis/): Old sheds demolished and hauled off.
- [Fence Removal](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/fence-removal-indianapolis/): Old fencing pulled out and hauled away.
- [Furniture Removal](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/furniture-removal-indianapolis/): Couches, dressers, tables and more picked up.
- [Mattress Removal](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/mattress-removal-indianapolis/): Mattresses and box springs hauled away.
- [Appliance Removal](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/appliance-removal-indianapolis/): Refrigerators, washers, dryers and stoves removed.
- [TV Removal](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/tv-removal-indianapolis/): Old TVs and electronics hauled away.
- [Hot Tub Removal](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/hot-tub-removal-indianapolis/): Hot tubs and spas cut up and hauled off.
- [Hoarder Cleanouts](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/hoarder-cleanouts-indianapolis/): Respectful, thorough cleanouts for heavy clutter.
- [Basketball Goal Removal](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/basketball-goal-removal-indianapolis/): Portable and in-ground goals removed and hauled.
- [Trampoline Removal](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/trampoline-removal-indianapolis/): Trampolines taken down and hauled away.
- [Construction Debris Removal](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/construction-debris-removal-indianapolis/): Job-site scraps and build waste cleared fast.
- [Yard Debris Removal](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/yard-debris-removal-indianapolis/): Yard waste, clippings and old landscaping hauled.
- [Storm Debris Cleanup](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/storm-debris-cleanup-indianapolis/): Limbs, damaged items and storm mess cleared.
- [Roofing Debris Removal](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/roofing-debris-removal-indianapolis/): Shingles and roofing waste hauled away.
- [Remodeling Debris Removal](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/remodeling-debris-removal-indianapolis/): Kitchen, bath and room remodel waste removed.
- [Demolition Debris Removal](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/demolition-debris-removal-indianapolis/): Tear-out and demolition waste cleared away.
- [Brush Removal](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/brush-removal-indianapolis/): Brush, overgrowth and tree trimmings hauled away.
